fusions.name: Furnace Maul
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then mauls it, which deals 14 damage, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Roar
fusions.desc: Roars a cone of flame that deals 28 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and ignores resistances. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Winter Den
fusions.desc: Lights a fire where you stand that reaches 3 tiles. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Slow to Rouse
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a burst of flame strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
